retrieved.content: Recent migration to transformer based architectures in language modeling from LSTM models is justified as Transformer-XL obtains strong perplexity results. BERT model also obtains very low pseudo-perplexity scores but it is inequitable to the unidirectional models. Our major contributions in this project, is the use of Transformer-XL architectures for the Finnish language in a sub-word setting, and the formulation of pseudo perplexity for the BERT model. Further comparisons between the transformer architectures can be made by downstreaming it to an ASR task, which will be explored in the future.
